answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by binding identity to a continuous chain of original graded work that vests rewards slowly. Each epoch demands a unique explanation of mechanisms, judged by a peer jury whose scores determine emission. An attacker must cultivate a long vine of distinct high-quality answers for every fake identity; a hollow farm collapses under the lotus-like scarcity of genuine novel reasoning, as the cumulative cost of sustained originality far exceeds any short-term gain from multiplicity.
